module: Collision ("crash") detector for tracked vehicles. On each frame it compares the vehicle's damage (map.objects[id].damage and sum of section damage) to a threshold that drops as the jerk (forward/backward acceleration jerk) increases, groups close impacts into one crash, then emits hooks. A modder adds a vehicle with addTrackedVehicleById() and listens to onVehicleCrashStarted / onVehicleCrashEnded (used notably by missions and damage gameplay). Depends on gameplay_util_damageAssessment to describe the damaged areas.
usage:
gameplay_util_crashDetection.addTrackedVehicleById(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0), {minDamage = 150, enableImpactLocationData = true}, "monMod")
local function onVehicleCrashEnded(data) dump(data.totalDamage, data.vehId) end
notes: Emitted hooks: onVehicleCrashStarted({vehId, vehImpactPos, vehImpactSpeed}) on the first impact of a crash; onNewImpactStarted({newImpactData}) for subsequent impacts of the same crash; onVehicleCrashEnded({impacts, sanitizedData = {touchedVehIds, initialImpactPos, initialImpactSpeed}, totalDamage, vehId}).
Internal constants: per-frame damage threshold 40, crash ends after 1.8 s without a new impact (or speed < minVelocity), maximum impact duration 0.3 s.

crashSettings defaults: minAccel 0, maxAccel 100, minDamage 150, maxDamage 5000, verticallyUnweighted false, minVelocity 1, groupImpactsDist 1 (minimum 0.1), enableImpactLocationData false. The table passed as argument is modified in place.

addTrackedVehicleById does nothing (no log) if the id is nil/negative or if the vehicle is missing from map.objects or from the scene tree; it does not check whether the vehicle is already tracked and then resets its data.
The vehicle is automatically removed from the list if it disappears from map.objects or on onVehicleDestroyed.
Debug mode (setDebug(true)) draws spheres/texts and opens an ImGui window with graphs.
onSerialize/onDeserialized serialize the whole trackedVehIds table, including debug ImGui pointers.

addTrackedVehicleById.desc: Starts tracking a vehicle to detect its crashes, with optional sensitivity settings.

crashSettings.desc: minAccel, maxAccel, minDamage, maxDamage, verticallyUnweighted, minVelocity (m/s), groupImpactsDist (m), enableImpactLocationData.

owner.desc: Caller name, for debugging ("unknown" by default).

isVehCrashing.desc: Returns whether a tracked vehicle is currently in a crash.

isVehTracked.desc: Returns whether the vehicle is in the tracking list.

resetCrashData.desc: Resets the crash, current impact and pre-impact data of a tracked vehicle (without removing it).

setDebug.desc: Enables or disables debug drawing and the ImGui window.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: updates accelerations, impact detection, end of pre-impact/impact/crash for each tracked vehicle; removes those that no longer exist.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called when Lua extensions are reloaded: returns the state (tracked vehicles, debug).

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload: restores the serialized state.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: removes it from tracking.
